_doc: Pearl flag/var/trainer -> Black 2 id registry, written by b2tools/pearl_ids.py (rules in its docstring; notes/STORY.md "Ids"). An id once given is kept: edit only by rerunning the tool.

PVAR_STARTER.why: Pearl keeps the starter species in its save (pokediamond GetStarter); written when the starter is given

PVAR_PC_TOWN.why: the Pokémon Center 1F the player came up from (its Black 2 zone), so the one shared 2F sends the player back down there (patches/pearl_centers.py, notes/LINK.md)

PVAR_HABITAT_VISITED_0.why: the Pokédex HABITAT list's visited places 0-15 (one bit each, set on entering a zone of the place: patches/sinnoh_pokedex.py; HoennB2's VAR_HABITAT_VISITED_0)

PVAR_HABITAT_VISITED_1.why: the Pokédex HABITAT list's visited places 16-31 (one bit each, set on entering a zone of the place: patches/sinnoh_pokedex.py; HoennB2's VAR_HABITAT_VISITED_1)

PVAR_HABITAT_VISITED_2.why: the Pokédex HABITAT list's visited places 32-47 (one bit each, set on entering a zone of the place: patches/sinnoh_pokedex.py; HoennB2's VAR_HABITAT_VISITED_2)

PVAR_HABITAT_VISITED_3.why: the Pokédex HABITAT list's visited places 48-63 (one bit each, set on entering a zone of the place: patches/sinnoh_pokedex.py; HoennB2's VAR_HABITAT_VISITED_3)

PVAR_PASTORIA_GYM_PRESS.why: map-local (cleared on a zone change): the Pastoria Gym's button press, a script-C handshake: 1 = pressed (the water moves), 0 = it stopped (pl_PressPastoriaGymButton; the decomp's src/pearlb2/pastoria_gym_itcm.c; chapter 5a)

PVAR_UG_RETURN_ZONE.why: the Grand Underground: where the player went down (the zone and the tile ZONE; the Explorer Kit's "go up" returns there, as Pearl's saved location; src/pearlb2/underground_itcm.c, notes/UNDERGROUND.md)

PVAR_UG_RETURN_X.why: the Grand Underground: where the player went down (the zone and the tile X; the Explorer Kit's "go up" returns there, as Pearl's saved location; src/pearlb2/underground_itcm.c, notes/UNDERGROUND.md)

PVAR_UG_RETURN_Y.why: the Grand Underground: where the player went down (the zone and the tile Y; the Explorer Kit's "go up" returns there, as Pearl's saved location; src/pearlb2/underground_itcm.c, notes/UNDERGROUND.md)

PVAR_UG_RETURN_Z.why: the Grand Underground: where the player went down (the zone and the tile Z; the Explorer Kit's "go up" returns there, as Pearl's saved location; src/pearlb2/underground_itcm.c, notes/UNDERGROUND.md)

PVAR_UG_HIDEAWAY_BATTLES.why: the Grand Underground: wild battles in the Hideaways (counted by src/pearlb2/underground_itcm.c, to 0xFFFF): Pearl's Spiritomb counter (GetSpiritombTalkCounter, the Hallowed Tower: 32), which counts people talked to in the multiplayer Underground (the lead 2026-10-26: 32 Hideaway battles instead)

PVAR_DELIVERY.why: the Pokémart deliveryman's gifts given, 0-4, in order: Member Card, Oak's Letter, Azure Flute, Manaphy Egg (Pearl's Mystery Gift events built in, after the Hall of Fame: pearl_story "The deliveryman"; chapter 9a, 2026-10-26)

PVAR_GIMMICK_REQUEST.why: map-local (cleared on a zone change): one script-to-gimmick handshake for any PearlB2 gimmick from chapter 8 on (the lead, 2026-10-26): the script writes a request (the Sunyshore Gym's button: 1 + Pearl's button type; a platform lift's ride: 1) and waits until the zone's gimmick sets it back to 0 (pl_RotateSunyshoreGymGear, pl_TriggerPlatformLiftRide; the decomp's src/pearlb2/sunyshore_gym_itcm.c, pearl_platforms_itcm.c)

PVAR_TROPHY_GARDEN_1.why: the Trophy Garden's daily Pokémon, slot 1 (a species, 0 = none): Mr. Backlot's AddTrophyGardenMon writes it (pearl_story.inc pl_AddTrophyGardenMon); the wild code puts slots 1 and 2 on grass slots 6 and 7 with the National Pokédex

PVAR_TROPHY_GARDEN_2.why: the Trophy Garden's daily Pokémon, slot 2 (a species, 0 = none): Mr. Backlot's AddTrophyGardenMon writes the old slot 1 here (pearl_story.inc pl_AddTrophyGardenMon); the wild code puts slots 1 and 2 on grass slots 6 and 7 with the National Pokédex

PVAR_FOLLOWER_SLOT.why: the party slot of the Pokémon that follows the player (written by the follower module, include/follower.h; its talk script, global 10017, names that Pokémon and plays its cry)

PFLAG_EXP_SHARE_OFF.why: the Exp. Share switched off in the Bag (patches/exp_share.py): clear = on, so the Exp. Share works as soon as it is received (PFLAG_010B), as Gen 6 gives it

PFLAG_NEWS_PRESS_TODAY.why: the Solaceon News Press assignment was given today (pearl_story SetNewsPressDeadline / GetNewsPressDeadline: Pearl counts its own deadline days in its save; "bring it today, before the date rolls over"; chapter 4b, 2026-10-25)
